prompt: Premium studio product photography of a new Ülker snack concept: a layered crispy wafer bar with pistachio and salted caramel. One modern flow-wrap package, vibrant flavor-inspired colors, appetizing cutaway product visuals and only the selected real ingredients. On the package, print the brand "Ülker", the exact product name "Fıstık Karamel Katı", the exact short slogan "Toplantı arasına tatlı tuzlu bir durak." and a small "YENİ" badge; no invented copy, additional slogans or text outside the package. Art direction: Warm pistachio green and caramel tones, with layered wafer pieces and pistachio accents centered on pack, caramel flowing diagonally, soft light highlighting crisp textures. Soft gradient studio background with a refined podium. Photorealistic premium commercial lighting, vertical 4:5. Leave the bottom 8% calm for the kiosk signature without a blank strip.
